description: Source code for managing loose object index mapping in a Git repository, including functions for initializing, loading, writing, and clearing loose object maps, as well as handling object ID pairs and file I/O operations.

methods.name: loose_object_map_init
methods.description: Initializes a loose object map with hash maps for compatibility and storage object IDs.

methods.name: repo_read_loose_object_map
methods.description: Loads the loose object map from disk for the repository.

methods.name: repo_write_loose_object_map
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map to disk.

methods.name: repo_add_loose_object_map
methods.description: Adds a new object ID pair to the loose object map and updates the index file.

methods.name: repo_loose_object_map_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped object ID for a given source object ID.

methods.name: loose_object_map_clear
methods.description: Clears and frees the loose object map.
